title: kbext.py verify fails a valid backlog_commands module that wraps a shipped command with bl_cli.extend
goal: kbext.py verify loads a backlog_commands module with the shipped commands registered, as backlog.py does, so a module that extends a shipped command passes verify when backlog.py loads it

options: kbext imports backlog and loads the module inside bl_cli.group_loading, which restores the registry
